resumeParse.title: Review resume suggestions
resumeParse.description: Create a private draft from a resume you choose. Uploading a file does not start AI processing. Your profile changes only after you choose fields and confirm.
resumeParse.unavailable: AI resume suggestions are currently unavailable. You can still upload resumes, edit your profile, review an existing draft, discard it or withdraw consent.
resumeParse.disclosure: With your separate consent and an explicit request, career-related text extracted from the selected resume is sent to Anthropic to suggest profile content. It may contain personal data. AI can make mistakes; review and edit every field you choose. Suggestions remain private and are not saved to your profile until you confirm. Withdrawing consent cancels pending drafts and removes their suggestions; it cannot recall data already sent or undo profile changes you previously confirmed.

matching.studentDescription: Request suggestions using your confirmed career information. Your resume and private drafts are not used. Suggestions may be imperfect; you choose which jobs to explore.
matching.employerDescription: Request suggestions using this job's public career information. Each request uses your ordinary talent-search allowance. Opening a profile follows the existing viewing and contact-unlock rules.
matching.disclosure: With your separate consent, limited career information from your saved profile is sent to Voyage AI for matching. This includes your headline, major, degree level, skills, job preferences and preferred locations. Your name, contacts, resume, private drafts and profile summary are excluded. Consent allows job suggestions for you and, only while you meet the talent-pool visibility rules, matching your profile to employers' published jobs. Matching does not grant contact access. You can withdraw at any time to stop future use of your profile for matching, but withdrawal cannot recall information already sent.

marketing.preferencesDescription: Choose whether this account receives weekly recommendation emails.
marketing.title: Weekly recommendation emails
marketing.studentDescription: Choose to receive at most one weekly email of job recommendations at your verified account email. Recommendations use your saved profile and require a separate current matching consent. No email is sent when there are no eligible recommendations.
marketing.employerDescription: Choose to receive a weekly talent summary at your verified account email. Summaries are sent only to owners of active, verified companies with an eligible published job. They show anonymous talent information and use the existing talent search quota.
marketing.independent: This choice is separate from profile visibility, resume parsing and AI matching. Saving it does not change those choices or send an email now. Essential account and application emails are unaffected.
marketing.recorded: A choice to receive these emails is recorded. Sending still requires the current policy and eligibility checks. You can withdraw it below or explicitly confirm the current choice again.
